readerd_download_source_reason: Open a file to download its source.
readerd_visual_mode_hint: Draw the source as formatted text while you edit.
readerd_run_code_hint: Run this document's code on this computer. Off whenever a document opens.
readerd_demo_banner: Demo sandbox. Nothing is saved, and some features are disabled. Sign in to keep your work.
readerd_sign_in_to_open: Sign in to open this document
readerd_sign_in_to_open_body: Readers, commenters, and editors need to sign in before they can open a shared document.
readerd_cannot_show: This document cannot be shown right now
readerd_project_no_files: This project has no files yet.
readerd_lock_preview_hint: Lock the preview on a file with the eye in Files to keep a page here while you edit this one.
readerd_html_convert_failed: The HTML converter could not convert this document. It supports fewer LaTeX packages than the PDF compiler, so the PDF view (View > PDF) may still work.
readerd_diagnostics_converter: Diagnostics in the sidebar lists what the converter reported.
readerd_compiler_no_output: The compiler produced no {kind}, and Diagnostics has nothing to show for it. What it said:
readerd_browser_cannot_render_source: This browser cannot render this {format} source.
readerd_configure_latex: Configure the browser LaTeX renderer to view it.
readerd_desktop_can_render: The LibrePaper desktop app can render it on this computer.
readerd_fix_errors: Fix the errors in Diagnostics to produce a PDF preview.
readerd_browser_cannot_render_paged: This browser cannot render this {kind} document from source.
readerd_restore_moved: The project changed while this was open. Restore {name} over the project as it now stands? The current version will be preserved in history.
readerd_restore_description: Restore {name}. Every file in the project is replaced, and the current version is preserved in history.
readerd_delete_many_comments_body: This removes these comments and their replies for everyone. It cannot be undone.
readerd_delete_comment_body: This removes the comment and its replies for everyone. It cannot be undone.
readerd_delete_chat_body: This permanently deletes the shared chat history of this project for everyone who has access to it.
readerd_choose_identity: Choose how to identify yourself in this comment.
